## Automation / scheduler surface (§20.E)
- This change only modifies existing code: the `Commit and push report` step (id `commit_report`) of job `analyze-commit-notify` in `.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`. It adds no new script and no manual step.
- Entry points are unchanged: `workflow_dispatch` of `workflow-log-analysis.yml`, dispatched by `comprehensive-test-and-release.yml` (phase 2), by the `test-and-mark-stable.yml` smoke gate (snapshot-only) and by hand.
- No long-running supervisor and no DB work.
- No `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry, because no new script is added.

## Functions or modules to implement

### 1. `commit_report` step (`.github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml`, about lines 1445-1608)
Keep `name: Commit and push report`, `id: commit_report`, the `if:` and all three existing `env:` entries exactly as they are. Keep the purge block inline and byte-identical. `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py::test_log_analysis_purge_keeps_docs_open_projects_use_and_fails_closed` splits the YAML at this step's name and asserts on the purge text.

**New `env:` entries** (names checked: none exists anywhere in the repo):
- `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR: ${{ vars.WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR || 'true' }}`
- `WLA_ANALYZE_REPORT_FILE: ${{ steps.analyze.outputs.report_file }}`

The run body then reads `REPORT_FILE="${WLA_ANALYZE_REPORT_FILE:-}"` instead of the inline `${{ steps.analyze.outputs.report_file }}`. This hardens against injection and leaves no `${{ }}` in the body, so tests can run it.

**Validate `REPORT_FILE`** right after reading it. It must match `^analysis/workflow-optimization-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]+)?\.md$`. Otherwise emit `::error::` and exit 1. Today the analyze step only produces paths of this shape (the existing rename regex already assumes it).

**Mode parse:**
- `false`, `0`, `no` or `off` (case-insensitive) selects `mode=push`, the legacy path, unchanged byte for byte.
- Any other value selects `mode=pr`.

**PR mode, after `git commit`** (the purge, `git add`, the no-change early exit and the commit message are all unchanged):
1. `REPORT_PR_BRANCH="auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"`. Guard it with `^auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$` and fail with `::error::` if it does not match.
2. Reuse the existing retry-with-rename loop unchanged: fetch the target tip, rename on an upstream collision, then `git pull --rebase origin "${TARGET_BRANCH}"`. Only the push target changes, chosen by mode: `git push --force origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}"`. `--force` is justified because the branch is unique to this run and attempt and only this step writes it; a retry after a rename has to overwrite its own earlier push. The `TARGET_BRANCH` push stays exactly as it is in push mode.
3. Write the PR body to `${RUNNER_TEMP}/wla_report_pr_body.md`. Fixed text: report path, run URL, "Generated by workflow-log-analysis.yml". No issue references or keywords; in particular never the `tracking_issue` input.
4. Run `python3 scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py --pr-body-file "<body>" --fail-open-on-lookup-error`. A non-zero exit gives `::error::` and exit 1, and no PR is created (§21).
5. Create the PR (single attempt, because a create is not idempotent):
   - `gh pr create --base "${TARGET_BRANCH}" --head "${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}" --title "chore: add workflow log analysis report (${REPORT_FILE})" --body-file <body>`
   - Parse the URL and number the way `forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml`'s fallback step does: grep the github.com URL, and the trailing digits are the number.
   - On "already exists", look the PR up with `gh pr list --head "${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}" --base "${TARGET_BRANCH}" --state open --json number,url`.
   - Any other failure gives `::error::` and exit 1. That matches today's hard failure when the push is exhausted, and the report stays on the pushed branch.
6. `HEAD_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`. Try the direct merge: `gh pr merge "<n>" --squash --match-head-commit "${HEAD_SHA}"`.
   - Success: `delivery=pr_merged`. Then a fail-open cleanup `git push origin --delete "${REPORT_PR_BRANCH}" || ::warning::`. Do not use `gh --delete-branch`, which switches the local checkout mid-job.
   - Refused: `gh pr merge "<n>" --auto --squash --match-head-commit "${HEAD_SHA}"`. Success gives `delivery=pr_auto_merge`.
   - Both refused: `delivery=pr_open` with `::warning::` naming the PR URL. The step still exits 0, because the report is durable in the PR.
7. Add a comment block above the gh calls documenting the API budget, per §14: at most 3 gh invocations per committed run (create, direct merge, auto merge), plus 1 `gh pr list` only on the "already exists" path. Calls audited: the only existing API call in the step is `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` in in-flight mode (open tracking issues and orchestrator runs), which returns no PR data. No call when nothing changed; none in push mode.

**Outputs:**
- Keep `committed=` and `report_file=` written exactly as today. `report_file` is the post-rename path, and `committed=true` means the report commit is on the target branch or in a PR.
- Add alongside them: `delivery=<pushed|pr_merged|pr_auto_merge|pr_open>`, `report_pr_number=`, `report_pr_url=`, `report_branch=<TARGET_BRANCH or REPORT_PR_BRANCH>`.
- `report_branch` is `TARGET_BRANCH` when `delivery` is `pushed` or `pr_merged`; otherwise it is `REPORT_PR_BRANCH`.

**Log line:** exactly one line per committed run:
`WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY mode=<pr|push> outcome=<pushed|pr_merged|pr_auto_merge|pr_open> pr=<n|none> base=<branch> file=<path>`
Keys and order are fixed.

### 2. Job `analyze-commit-notify`
- Add a job-level `permissions:` block that copies the four workflow-level grants (`contents: write`, `actions: read`, `issues: write`, `id-token: write`) and adds `pull-requests: write`. The fallback `github.token` needs it to open and merge the PR. Do not widen the workflow-level block (least privilege; `collect-logs` already has its own block).
- Add the job output `report_delivery: ${{ steps.commit_report.outputs.delivery }}` alongside the existing `report_file` and `analysis_status` outputs (both unchanged).

### 3. Job `deep-audit` `if:` (about line 1667)
Append:
`&& (needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_delivery == '' || needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_delivery == 'pushed' || needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.report_delivery == 'pr_merged')`

Why: deep-audit pulls the target branch (line 1839) and fails with "Report file ... not found on target branch" (line 2004) when the report is not there yet. `api-redundancy` already needs `deep-audit.outputs.audit_status == 'completed'`, so it is gated in turn. Their own direct-push section steps (about lines 2156 and 2754) stay unchanged in P1. Before editing, grep `tests/` for the exact current `deep-audit` `if:` string.

### 4. `Send Telegram notification` step
- Add `env:` entries `WLA_REPORT_PR_URL: ${{ steps.commit_report.outputs.report_pr_url || '' }}` and `WLA_REPORT_DELIVERY: ${{ steps.commit_report.outputs.delivery || '' }}`.
- When `WLA_REPORT_DELIVERY` is `pr_auto_merge` or `pr_open` and the URL is not empty, print `Report PR: <url>` instead of the blob link, which would 404 until the PR merges. Every other case is unchanged.

## Data structures affected
- Step outputs, added only: `delivery`, `report_pr_number`, `report_pr_url`, `report_branch`.
- Job output, added only: `report_delivery`.
- New repo variable `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR`, default `true`.
- New branch namespace `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-<run_id>-<attempt>`.
- The report file format is unchanged.

## API or interface changes
- New gh calls are budgeted in item 1, step 7.
- Each committed run now opens a PR against the dispatch branch instead of pushing to it directly. Set `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_VIA_PR=false` to restore the direct push.
- New stable log prefix `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY`.

1. analyze → commit_report: purge (unchanged) → commit → fetch/rename/rebase loop.
